author: B

components.title: Tokenize & validate format
components.what: Use a strict regex (e.g. r'^\s*(\d+[hms]\s*)*$' plus per-part r'(\d+)([hms])') to ensure the whole string, after stripping leading/trailing whitespace, consists only of digit+unit tokens separated by optional whitespace, with no whitespace between a number and its unit, no decimals, and nothing else

components.title: Enforce uniqueness & compute seconds
components.what: Iterate matched (number, unit) pairs, raise ValueError on a repeated unit, then sum number*3600/60/1 per unit into an int result, raising ValueError if zero parts were found (covers empty-string and pure-whitespace cases).
